description: This file implements a bi-directional multimap data structure for managing object labels and selectors, primarily used in Kubernetes controller logic for efficient object association management.

classes.name: BiMultimap
classes.description: A thread-safe, bi-directional mapping structure for associating objects with labels and selectors.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents a unique object identifier with name and namespace.

classes.name: selectorKey
classes.description: A serialized form of a selector for caching associations.

classes.name: selectingObject
classes.description: Represents an object with an associated label selector.

classes.name: selectingObjects
classes.description: A collection of selectingObjects with reference counting.

classes.name: labelsKey
classes.description: A serialized form of labels for caching associations.

classes.name: labeledObject
classes.description: Represents an object with associated labels.

classes.name: labeledObjects
classes.description: A collection of labeledObjects with reference counting.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Converts a string in 'namespace/name' format into a Key object.

methods.name: Put
methods.description: Inserts or updates an object and its label associations.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a labeled object and its associations.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if a labeled object exists in the map.

methods.name: PutSelector
methods.description: Associates a selector with an object, creating or updating associations.

methods.name: DeleteSelector
methods.description: Removes a selector and its associations.

methods.name: SelectorExists
methods.description: Checks if a selector is present.

methods.name: KeepOnly
methods.description: Retains only specified labeled objects, deleting others.

methods.name: KeepOnlySelectors
methods.description: Retains only specified selectors, deleting others.

methods.name: Select
methods.description: Returns objects associated with a selector.

methods.name: ReverseSelect
methods.description: Returns selectors associated with a labeled object.
